description: This file defines a data structure for Gateway setup payloads and a utility enum with methods to decode such payloads from raw strings, including JSON and Base64 encoded formats.

classes.name: GatewaySetupPayload
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the payload data required for gateway setup, including optional fields for URL, host, port, TLS, bootstrap token, token, and password.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: A static enum providing methods to decode a GatewaySetupPayload from a raw string, supporting JSON and Base64 formats.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string into a GatewaySetupPayload, trying JSON first, then Base64 decoding.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GatewaySetupPayload.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string (with adjusted padding) into an UTF-8 string.
